subject: Maximum number of variables in lavaan

messages.author: 0325c6a976085eab
messages.subject: Maximum number of variables in lavaan
parts:
Is there a limit to the number of variables that can be included in a lavaan model (beyond the memory or processor limitations of the computer you are running on)?

I want to code a model with ridiculous numbers of variables (thousands) for a meta-analysis, but don't want to spend the the writing the code if it won't work.

Thanks,

Jeremy

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Maximum number of variables in lavaan
parts:
On 05/11/2016 10:46 PM, Jeremy Miles wrote:
>
> Is there a limit to the number of variables that can be included in a
> lavaan model (beyond the memory or processor limitations of the computer
> you are running on)?

> I want to code a model with ridiculous numbers of variables (thousands)
> for a meta-analysis, but don't want to spend the the writing the code if
> it won't work.

It might work. But it may be slow, and you may need a lot of memory. I
would suggest first trying with se="none" and test="none", and nothing
robust. Robust test statistics require huge matrices (at least in lavaan).

You may also want to try out dev 0.5-21, where I recently changed a few
lines of code (part of the large 'de-vec-ization' of lavaan's code, long
story) which may save you quite some memory space. See:

https://github.com/yrosseel/lavaan/commit/d7a7556203414c1c9fbed9fac59764b857f7388b

Let us know how well it works (or not).

Yves.
